identity_lock.description: Lean, wiry, dignified June Oxley; sparse white horseshoe hair; fitted short white beard; pale blue-gray eyes; long crooked nose; narrow jaw; weathered asymmetry.

style_lock.medium: Premium theatrical stylized 3D with painterly 2.5D finishing.

style_lock.lighting: Warm 4300K back-left sun key, broad cool sky fill, restrained visible 2700K lantern.
